blocks.text: JBL Live 770NC headphones deliver powerful JBL Signature Sound in a comfortable over-ear headband style. When you're deep in your flow, True Adaptive Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient technology keeps you free from distractions. Or, if you want to keep an ear open to the world around you, you can even have a conversation without taking the headphones off. Easily access your preferred voice assistant with either a hotword or a tap on the earcup to play your favorite playlist, text your friend, check the weather, and much more. You’ll enjoy 65 hours (50 hours with BT+ANC on) of music streaming. Need even more? A 5-minute speed charge gets you another four hours. The JBL Live 770NC can connect with two Bluetooth® devices simultaneously, so you’ll never have to miss a call even if you’re watching a movie on your tablet.

items.label: JBL Signature Sound and surround sound
items.value: Along with powerful JBL Signature Sound, the 40mm drivers offer immersive JBL Spatial Sound that turns any stereo content from any device into virtual surround sound.

items.label: Bluetooth 5.3 with LE audio supported*
items.value: Wirelessly stream high-quality sound even at lower bit rates with Bluetooth 5.3. Audio Mode gives the best available sound while Video Mode ensures the sound and visuals are always in sync. *Available via OTA update

items.label: True Adaptive Noise Cancelling with Smart Ambient
items.value: With four noise-sensing mics, True Adaptive Noise Cancelling means zero distractions whether you’re focusing on studying or getting lost in the music. Or turn on Smart Ambient to hear your surroundings.

items.label: Up to 65 hours* of battery life and speed charge
items.value: Listen wirelessly for up to 50 hours and recharge the battery in as little as 2 hours with the convenient Type-C USB cable. In a hurry? A quick 5 min charge gives you 4 hours of music. *BT on/ANC off

items.label: Auto play and pause
items.value: Take the headphones off, the music stops. Put it back on, the music starts again. It genuinely couldn't be simpler.

items.label: Built-In Media
items.value: 1 x Cloth Carrying Pouch, 1 x Detachable audio cable, 1 x JBL Live 770NC headphones, 1 x QSG, 1 x USB-C Charging Cable, 1 x Warranty/Warning
